content.short: Skymon is a collection of 10,000 unique live NFTs on Cardano designed for immersive metaverse utility.
content.description: Skymon is a pioneering digital collectible project on the Cardano blockchain, featuring a limited collection of 10,000 unique 'live' NFTs. These digital creatures are specifically designed for integration into virtual social hubs and metaverse environments, where they can evolve and interact based on user engagement. The project emphasizes the transition from static PFPs to interactive assets that hold utility across multiple platforms. By providing high-quality 3D modeling and a lore-driven universe, Skymon offers a dynamic ownership experience for the Cardano NFT community.
content.meta: Skymon features 10,000 unique Cardano NFTs with live interactive traits and metaverse utility. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
